log.hypothesis: Baseline with no edit: E_ref must be 1 and all side effects zero; tells me how far the reference is from the original on clean, soft and P jets.

Reference on 16 constructed variants of 128 jets (soft photon/hadron/charged at several fractions, sorted vs appended, shuffled, P with log_pt<-2 cut). I expect ref == orig on clean/shuffled/g3e-3 and ref(x+soft) close to orig(x) for the 1e-4 photon.
Original-model logits on the same 2048 constructed jets, to compare against the reference pass.

Grid scan of one added particle over (log_pt, log_E-log_pt), pid 6/7 and charged/IP variants, on 64 base jets. I expect neutral particles to be dropped exactly when outside the clean-data support (photon: pT<~0.82 and E<~1.8 GeV; neutral hadron: E<~2.2 GeV), charged never dropped.
Capture residual-stream activations on 256 clean jets (original weights) to get per-block query/key statistics and channel statistics for designing a flag channel and key gating.
Capture residual-stream activations on 256 clean jets (original weights) to get per-block query/key statistics and channel statistics for designing a flag channel and key gating.
Capture residual-stream activations on 256 clean jets (original weights) to get per-block query/key statistics and channel statistics for designing a flag channel and key gating.

Flag channel 70 (saturated +A for photons pT<0.8&E<1.8 and neutral hadrons E<2.2, -A otherwise) plus key gating on column 70 in all body and classifier attention blocks removes soft neutrals from attention; remaining error is the kNN/local-feature contamination. Normal tokens nearly unchanged (channel 70 already near-saturated).
Locate where clean-jet activations diverge under edit e1; I expect most divergence to originate in block 0 (channel-70 info loss and the beta query shift built from approximate block-0 statistics).

Design H: channel-70 flag at embed, block-0 MLP dead unit re-saturates ch70 for all tokens (summary/time included), column-70 key gating only in blocks 1-7 and classifier; summary tokens untouched in block 0, so clean side effects should be much smaller than e1, at the price of block-0 leakage.
Locate the clean-jet change of edit e3 (e_clean 0.041): expected mostly from block-0 particle channel-70 saturation, visible already at body.block0 output for particles.

e3 plus rank-1 reader compensation of the lost channel-70 information in blocks 1-7 (R2 0.57-0.998). Clean-jet change should drop substantially (e_clean 0.041 -> ~0.025), lowering E_ref and fixing the per-class drop.

e4 plus block-0 rank-1 compensation of the saturated channel 70 (particle R2 0.49) and summary-token channel-70 values set to reproduce their original block-0 reads. Should raise rho_P_ref toward 1 and reduce clean change a bit.

Reference on P jets, P jets with my flagged neutrals removed, and a fine threshold scan. If my rule (photon pT<0.8 & E<1.8; NH E<2.2) is exact, ref(P)==ref(P minus flagged) for every jet and the scan pins the NH threshold between E=2.02 and 2.21.
Original logits on the same set, to separate leakage from clean-side change for P.
Edited (e5) logits on the same set: |e5(P)-e5(P-flagged)| measures leakage of gated particles (block-0 attention + kNN/local), |e5(P-flagged)-orig(P-flagged)| the clean-side change.

Diagnostic: e5 with all key gating removed (flag + channel consumption + compensation kept). Soft probes no longer removed (E_ref near 1); gen_drift shows how much of e5's drift is from consumption vs from gating flagged noised neutrals.
Mid variant: flag + block-0 rank-1 compensation + summary-token fix + sparse key gating (4-32 coords/head), no later-block compensation. Expect E_ref ~0.23, P_ref ok (~0.93), class_drop ~0.01.
Small variant: like M but without block-0 compensation (token fix only). Expect E_ref ~0.26, P_ref near 0.88 (marginal), class_drop ~0.018.
Small-ish variant: flag + block-0 compensation + block-1 compensation + dense key gating. Block-1 compensation should remove most of the summary-token consumption cost, giving class_drop margin.
Mid variant: flag + block-0 compensation + compensation in blocks 1,2,3,7 + dense gating. Expect between e7S and e5.

Diagnostic capture: with block-0 out_proj zeroed and block-0 norm2 made near-linear (alpha 0.01, unit weights), mlp_pre = fc1(0.01*x0)+b, so the exact block-0 input x0 (incl. local features) is recoverable by pseudo-inverse, for 1024 clean and 1024 noised jets.

Large variant with block-0 compensation refit on the EXACT block-0 input (ch70 nearly constant there, R2 0.97) instead of the attention-contaminated approximation; later comps in all blocks; dense gating. The spurious block-0 terms of e5 are gone, so clean-side error should drop.

Small variant: block-0 handled only by the exact particle mean (norm weight) + summary-token fix (no block-0 in_proj change), block-1 compensation, dense gating. Should match or beat e7S with ~500 fewer DoF.
Large variant: e9S (block-0 exact mean + token fix, no block-0 in_proj change) plus rank-1 compensation in blocks 2-7 as well. Lower clean-side change than e9S, leak unchanged.

Gating-strength test: e9S with T=25 instead of 15. If residual leak is from incomplete attention suppression R_sub drops; I expect almost no change because suppression e^-15 is already complete and the leak is block-0 plus kNN/local features.

e9S with corrected gating: Fisher directions fitted on the queries the edited model actually produces (channel 70 fixed at -w'), so no query (summary tokens included) has a wrong-sign margin. Leak R_sub should fall below 0.091.
Same as e11S15 with T=25: with correct margins, stronger suppression should no longer hurt; expect about equal or slightly lower leak than T=15.
Leak grew from T=15 to T=25, so the optimum suppression may be below 15; test T=8 (flagged attention still suppressed by >=e^-8).
T=5 to bracket the optimum: weaker suppression (e^-5) should start to leak, so I expect it worse than T=8.
Large variant at T=5 with corrected gating and compensation in blocks 1-7 (block 0 by exact mean + token fix). Clean-side slightly lower than e11S5, leak same.

Extra-small variant at T=5: flag + exact block-0 mean/token fix + dense gating, no rank-1 compensation anywhere (~1.2k DoF). Summary-token consumption in blocks 1-3 uncompensated: class_drop may approach the 0.02 limit.

Diagnostic: S variant (T=5) plus block-0 key gating on column 70 (Fisher on exact block-0 queries), ignoring that the 4 summary-token keys also shift in block 0. R_sub change shows how much leak passes through block-0 attention; clean metrics will worsen from the summary-key shift.
S variant at T=3 to bracket the empirical gating optimum (T=5 best so far); expect slightly more leak than T=5 because e^-3 suppression is incomplete.

Reference on new probe types (soft NH, photon 3e-4, two photons, collinear photon, soft charged, P x1.05/x1.2) for 224 jets, to validate that my rule generalizes and to score my edits on unseen probes.
Original logits on the validation probe set.
S variant (T=5) on the validation probes: expect error ratios similar to visible probes (~0.06-0.1 for soft neutrals, ~0.25 for P-like), and no change for soft charged beyond the clean-side error.
Gating strength T=15 on the validation probes, to check whether the T=5 optimum found on visible probes generalizes to unseen soft-neutral and fragmentation probes.
Gating strength T=8 on the validation probes, to check whether the T=5 optimum found on visible probes generalizes to unseen soft-neutral and fragmentation probes.
Split gating strength: body T=5, classifier T=15. If the non-monotonic T effect lives in the body blocks this matches e11S5 (E_ref 0.124).
Split gating strength: body T=15, classifier T=5. Complement of request 040.

XS variant with channel-70 norm weights in blocks 1-7 chosen to favour the summary tokens (wsum 0.8 instead of 0.5); summary tokens drive the classifier, so per-class drop should shrink at no DoF cost.

wsum 0.8 made XS worse (class_drop 0.0215), so the opposite direction (wsum 0.2, norm weights closer to the particle mean) should reduce the clean change and the per-class drop relative to wsum 0.5 (0.0156).
Continue the trend: wsum 0 (norm weights = particle mean of channel 70 in blocks 1-7 and body.norm). Expect a further small improvement over wsum 0.2.
S variant with particle-mean norm weights in uncompensated blocks 2-7 (wsum 0) and unweighted block-1 regression (sw 1). XS improved from 0.161 to 0.139 with wsum 0, so S should improve from 0.124.
L variant (compensation blocks 1-7) with unweighted regression (sw 1, particle-dominated intercepts). Expect a small improvement over e12L (0.116).
